tools.name: query_model
tools.description: Query the local LLM. To include files, use absolute paths.

systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt. Overrides the default assistant prompt.

tools.name: llm_session_create
tools.description: Create a long-lived LLM session with a PINNED model, optionally ingesting a file set once (the cheap-model codebase-analyst pattern). Returns a sessionId for llm_session_query. Sessions expire after an idle TTL; the Gateway stays stateless — the message history is replayed per call.

model.description: Chat model to pin (e.g. a cheap long-context model). Validated against the Gateway at create time.

files.description: Absolute paths to ingest into the session context

systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt for the session

tools.name: llm_session_query
tools.description: Query a pinned-model session — the model retains all prior context (ingested files + earlier turns). Optional per-call model overrides the pin for this call only.

model.description: Optional per-call model override (does not change the session pin)

tools.name: llm_session_close
tools.description: Close a pinned-model session and free its state.
